text: Metal roofs and steel structures shall be used as natural air terminals and down conductors where their thickness and continuity comply with IEC 62305-3; a lightning protection zone concept (LPZ) with surge protective devices of type 1+2 at the building entries and type 2 / 3 at cabinets and sensitive instrument loops (coordinated per IEC 62305-4). Surge arresters at the GIS cable / line entries and at the GSU and generator terminals per the insulation coordination study.
